plain_description.what: Gives the LLM judge a per-cell verification kit: a knowledge card, a list of common failures and two worked neighbour examples. It compares judge accuracy with and without the kit on 944 key-decidable matches. About 8,000 judge calls.
plain_description.why: Tests whether cell-specific background material makes the judge more accurate than the existing best recipe.
plain_description.information: A gain would show that the taxonomy can improve the judge itself. No gain would close this route. Result: failed. The gain was +0.7 points (p = 0.39), with a +4.1-point hint in the top cluster that is not significant. There was no difference between quantitative and discursive questions. A later review put the honest estimate near +1.3 points because of control noise. The run had no question-pool check at the time. Later ruled history rather than evidence, because it ran on the older question pool.
